newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends lower, breaches 26.30 barrier.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends lower, breaches 26.30 barrier.

text.p: The Philippine peso closed weaker at 26.301 to the dollar from Thursday's 26.288 as foreign banks bought dollars to cover short positions, brokers said.
Foreign banks have been servicing huge commercial dollar demands after foreign fund managers cashed in their portfolio investments in time for year-end financial reporting, one trader said.
"There was short-covering early in the trade due to outflow of arbitrage money," he said. The peso reached an intra-day low of 26.302 in the morning.
However, local banks easily met the demand since they have been receiving steady dollar inflows from overseas workers.
Turnover was moderate with $148.4 million, slightly higher than Thursday's $132.60 million.
The Central Bank did not intervene in the market, posting its buying rate at 26.90 and selling rate at 26.305.
The peso is expected to slip next week as portfolio managers wind down their positions.-RAMONCITO DELA CRUZ 632 8418938
